profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Advantor Systems
profile.summary: With over 27 years of experience in software engineering, I currently serve as a Lead Software Engineer at Sabre Corporation, specializing in Java frameworks, performance optimization, and SQL. My role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational efficiency and product reliability. Previously, I contributed to long-term, impactful projects as an Advisory Software Engineer at Fiserv. Passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex challenges, I aim to drive innovation and support Sabre’s mission of advancing travel technology with precision and efficiency.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a cross-functional team of engineers and designers to develop a new Hotel Reservation system to include Retail Products in addition to rooms, primarily using Java and Spring Boot, Liquibase and Hibernate.   The multi-server application leveraged GCP cloud platform, Spanner, BigQuery, Pub/Sub and Cloud functions along with Terraform for infrastructure deployment.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: Supervised team of developers and business analysts engaged in creating a Full-Stack Workflow Business Process Automation system utilizing Java, Spring Boot and Flowable BPMN along with a Typescript/Angular front end.  Users were able to generate customizable BPMN workflows with both automated functions and user tasks to streamline exception processing in their monthly account balancing activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a Java-based pilot project utilizing Java Swing and Servlets to support high-traffic customer invoice and claims processing applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed complex income tax software for accountants, implementing automated tax calculation logic and electronic filing capabilities.  Collaborated with domain experts to translate intricate tax laws into scalable software requirements and functional API designs.
